metadata.fullname: AWS Well-Architected Framework (Nov 2026 release) - Security Pillar & Cloud Foundations [Preview]
metadata.description: Preview mapping for the AWS Well-Architected Framework release of 16 November 2026. Covers the Security pillar (SEC01-SEC11), the security-relevant Well-Architected Cloud Foundations capabilities (FND01-FND05, FND07) and Reliability backup/DR questions (REL09, REL13). Best practices that cannot be assessed through AWS APIs (for example threat modelling, simulations, training) are listed for manual review.
metadata.emptyCheckDefaultMsg: No automated check available for this best practice. Manual review required.
